scope: Full sanitized root export and working changes for public source publication; not production deployment or whole-application security certification.

findings.explanation: The first offline branch retained inherited MinIO credentials and Redis settings; entering the real application lifespan could rewrite an operator's bucket policy. Mocked reproduction invoked the actual policy-writing method against synthetic inherited settings without network access.
findings.verified_fix: Re-executed the original branch with synthetic operator environment variables. All five inherited MinIO/Redis values are now replaced with isolated test values.

findings.explanation: The batch-import command advertised by README failed before argument parsing with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named app when run from backend with no custom PYTHONPATH.
findings.verified_fix: Re-executed python scripts/maintenance/upload_new_posts.py --help from backend with empty PYTHONPATH, an absent review env file and isolated supported SQLite-file settings. Argument help printed and exit code was 0; no database mutation or uploads.

findings.explanation: The first lifespan fix used a function-scoped autouse lifespan replacement, but the shared client fixture was module-scoped and enters TestClient earlier. pytest --setup-plan confirmed client setup precedes isolate_offline_lifespan; shared-client tests therefore still initialized external services and background jobs.
findings.verified_fix: pytest --setup-plan now establishes session-scoped isolate_offline_lifespan before module client. Independently ran public-initialization and authentication tests: 13 passed, including the shared-client check that initialization remains untouched.

findings.reported_by: Implementer full-suite diagnosis, independently reproduced by reviewer
findings.explanation: After real/default operator credentials were removed for export, the pytest-collected manual photo workflow accessed an unset TEST_ADMIN_USERNAME and failed the required full-suite gate.
findings.verified_fix: Independently reproduced the missing-key error with no credentials. Then invoked the actual offline fixture and full photo workflow in module isolation: complete login/album/upload/detail/list sequence passed, wrong credentials were rejected, incomplete sequence failed teardown, inherited environment was restored, and explicit live opt-in did not replace operator requests/settings. No shared test database or network was used.

findings.explanation: Sanitizing skipped-test paths inserted a literal project placeholder with angle brackets into XML text. The public JUnit cannot be parsed: mismatched tag at line 1, column 6942. Raw final JUnit parses correctly and confirms test success, but the published machine evidence is structurally invalid.
findings.verified_fix: Reviewer independently parsed the XML-safe repair in the prior round and the final current-source public JUnit: 340 total, 321 passed, 0 failures/errors, 19 skipped. Generic hostname and plain placeholders remain; private-path pattern scan found no match.

findings.reported_by: Implementer first hosted Linux CI result; source guard independently verified by reviewer
findings.explanation: The first hosted Linux static-check job rejected direct ctypes.windll access in the Windows console helper, so the initial workflow did not supply the required successful Linux job.
findings.verified_fix: The helper returns False unless sys.platform is win32; reviewer simulated Linux with imports forbidden and confirmed return before ctypes import. Linux regression was added. Current reviewed SHA passed hosted Ubuntu and Windows static-check steps, independently verified through GitHub.

findings.reported_by: Implementer first hosted Windows CI result; current machine evidence and scope comparison independently inspected by reviewer
findings.explanation: The initial 43.53% coverage evidence preceded lifespan isolation and became stale. The first hosted Windows job measured 40.80%, below the unchanged 41.57% baseline.
findings.verified_fix: Meaningful isolated startup/authentication/password tests were appended to G2/G3 without removing the original six files, identities, other commands or fixed baseline. Reviewer directly exercised all eight new startup scenarios with zero external I/O. Fresh local coverage and independently read Ubuntu/Windows hosted logs all show 41.82% >= 41.57%; pre-isolation 43.53% evidence is superseded.
